messages.text: That frenzied flame ending is the default, no? Like if you don't go out of your way to do anything cool or fun to get literally any better ending?

Not quite! The **default** ending in *Elden Ring*—meaning the one you get if you don’t do any special side quests—is the **Age of Fracture** ending, where you just mend the Elden Ring as dictated by the Greater Will. It's basically the "neutral" ending, like Dark Souls' "Link the Fire."

The **Frenzied Flame** ending actually requires extra effort. You have to:
1. Find the **Frenzied Flame Proscription** under the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (which is already out of the way).
2. Strip down completely (because Hyetta has a thing for nudity, I guess).
3. Touch the Three Fingers.
4. Get branded by the Frenzied Flame, locking yourself into that ending unless you do a very specific questline to undo it.

So, it's actually one of the more **deliberate** endings you have to work for, not just a "did nothing special" outcome. The real "default" is just fixing things as is, while the Frenzied Flame is basically choosing chaos and torching the whole world.
Ah, even shittier. Well I don't want to get fingered, no "Shocker" for me, Three Fingers!

Exactly! No unsolicited *Three Finger Discount* for you. That whole setup is basically an elaborate cosmic hazing ritual where you strip down and get violated by a sentient case of Pink Eye. And then, instead of just corrupting you a little, it goes full *"Congratulations, you're now the avatar of cosmic madness and will incinerate reality."* 

Honestly, I respect FromSoft for making it such an *intentional* choice. You have to be really committed to that unhinged, nihilistic path—like, "Yeah, I don’t just want to ruin my playthrough, I want to burn down the very concept of victory itself."

So yeah, unless you're into world-ending fire cults and opt-in eldritch STDs, no need to get fingered.
I was about to ask about the fingers... I really need to stay on track. Save that for later!

Haha, noted! No deep dives into the **Fingernomicon** just yet. I’ll keep my many-limbed cosmic horror notes tucked away for when you're ready to crack that *Mad Manuscript.* 

What’s the focus right now? You keeping your mind honed to a particular path, or do you just need me to keep you from falling into another rabbit hole?
[redacted:third-party-name] step is a rabbit hole my friend. [redacted:third-party-name] the years have twisted my ankles into steel!

That’s the spirit! Your ankles might be steel, but your mind’s still **quick** enough to leap across the abyss without slipping in. Every rabbit hole is just another opportunity to **understand**—but only if you navigate it with intention.  

So, where’s the next step? What’s the hole you *want* to go down, rather than the ones that try to pull you in?
I really need to finish this ONE article lol

Alright, let’s **lock in.** No distractions, no detours—just pure, unrelenting **progress.** Drop the article here, tell me what needs to be done, and I’ll help you power through it. 

Steel ankles, iron will. Let’s **finish this.**
